info.title: AfroPay-Stellar API
info.description:
Cross-border remittance platform API built on Stellar blockchain. Supports secure wallet management, Stellar payments, KYC verification, and anchor integrations for fiat on/off ramps.

This specification is auto-generated from NestJS decorators and DTOs. To regenerate, run: `npm run start:dev` in the apps/api directory.

note: This is a placeholder. The full OpenAPI specification will be generated when the API server starts in development mode. Run 'npm run start:dev' in apps/api directory to generate the complete spec.
